create_unified_radial_mlp: create a UnifiedRadialMLP from a list of RadialMLP modules using the factory function
build_UnifiedRadialMLP: build a UnifiedRadialMLP that batches the first linear layer across N RadialMLPs for single GEMM
run_UnifiedRadialMLP_forward: run the forward pass of UnifiedRadialMLP to compute all N radial outputs in one batched operation
review_validate_radial_mlp: review the _validate_radial_mlp function that checks RadialMLP layer count, types, and feature dimensions
refactor_umas_radial_mlp: refactor the umas_radial_mlp method to apply layers 2+ with LayerNorm, SiLU, and Linear operations
